In addition to the known psoriasis markers IL17F and CXCL13 ( 9 ), these psoriasis-specific upregulated DEGs include granulysin GNLY and CTLA4 , whose loci have been linked genetically to psoriasis ( 42 , 43 ), KLRB1 , which is downregulated by the TNFα-blocker alefacept in psoriatic lesions ( 44 ), MGAT4 , which is downregulated during ustekinumab treatment of psoriatic arthritis ( 45 ), and PIK3R1 , whose germline loss of function impairs cutaneous immunity ( 46 ).
